prompt: The numbers from 0 to 9 are arranged in alphabetical order by their English names: 8 (eight), 5 (five), 4 (four), 9 (nine), 1 (one), 7 (seven), 6 (six), 3 (three), 2 (two), ... Which number comes last in this arrangement?
explanation: Sorting the names eight, five, four, nine, one, seven, six, three, two, zero alphabetically puts 'zero' last, since z comes after e, f, n, o, s and t. So the last number is 0.
